JSDoc: """ * Rule to validate @story annotation references refer to existing story files * @story docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md * @req REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE - Validate that story file paths reference existing files * @req REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION - Resolve relative paths correctly and enforce configuration * @req REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION - Prevent path traversal and absolute path usage """ - Uses utilities from src/utils/storyReferenceUtils.ts and helpers from src/rules/helpers/valid-story-reference-helpers.ts. - Core processing: - `handleComment` scans all comments, normalizes lines, and finds those starting with `@story` (REQ-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION). - `validateStoryPath` parses the @story line into a path token and delegates to `processStoryPath`. - `processStoryPath`: - Calls `performSecurityValidations` (absolute-path and traversal checks) before FS work (REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION). - If `requireExt` is true and `hasValidExtension(storyPath)` is false, reports `invalidExtension` with `data: { path }` (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION). - Calls `reportExistenceProblems` to resolve candidates and report `fileMissing` vs `fileAccessError` while enforcing project boundaries (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING). - `reportExistenceProblems`: - Invokes `normalizeStoryPath(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs)` to build candidates and compute an existence result based on cwd and storyDirectories (REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - Calls `handleProjectBoundaryForExistence` to reject candidates outside project root and report `invalidPath` when needed (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY). - Delegates to `reportExistenceStatus`: - If status = "missing": report `fileMissing` with original path. - If status = "fs-error": report `fileAccessError` with `{ path, error: errorMessage }` (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING). - `create(context: Rule.RuleContext)`: - Derives cwd as `(context as any).cwd ?? process.cwd()` (matches story guidance on using context.cwd with fallback to process.cwd; REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION). - Reads rule options `storyDirectories`, `allowAbsolutePaths`, and `requireStoryExtension` with defaults: - `storyDirs = opts?.storyDirectories || ["docs/stories", "stories"]` (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - `allowAbsolute = opts?.allowAbsolutePaths || false` (REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION/CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - `requireExt = opts?.requireStoryExtension !== false` (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - Program visitor iterates all comments via `context.getSourceCode().getAllComments()` and passes each to `handleComment` (integration with prior annotation detection stories). - `meta.messages` defines clear user-facing diagnostics (User Experience, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING): - `fileMissing: "Story file '{{path}}' not found"` - `invalidExtension: "Invalid story file extension for '{{path}}', expected '.story.md'"` - `invalidPath: "Invalid story path '{{path}}'"` - `fileAccessError: "Could not validate story file '{{path}}' due to a filesystem error: {{error}}. Please check file existence and permissions."` - `meta.schema` provides configuration options exactly as in the story’s example: - `storyDirectories: string[]` - `allowAbsolutePaths: boolean` - `requireStoryExtension: boolean`.
Helpers enforcing boundaries and security: - File: src/rules/helpers/valid-story-reference-helpers.ts - Header JSDoc ties directly to this story and requirements: - `@story docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md` - `@req REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY`, `@req REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION`, `@req REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS`. - `analyzeCandidateBoundaries(candidates, cwd)` uses `enforceProjectBoundary` to classify candidates as inside vs outside project, returning `{ hasInProjectCandidate, hasOutOfProjectCandidate }`. - `handleProjectBoundaryForExistence(...)`: - If candidates exist and all are out-of-project, calls `reportInvalidPath` and returns true, blocking further existence logic (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - If existenceResult indicates `status === "exists"` but `matchedPath` is outside project, also reports `invalidPath` and returns true. - `performSecurityValidations(...)`: - Rejects absolute paths with `invalidPath` when `allowAbsolute` is false. - When `allowAbsolute` is true, allows them but still relies on boundary and existence checks later (as described in the story’s implementation notes). - For paths with `..` or directory separators, resolves them and ensures resolved path stays under `cwd`; otherwise reports `invalidPath` (REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION).
Filesystem resolution and caching: - File: src/utils/storyReferenceUtils.ts - File header: - `@story docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md` - `@req REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION`, `REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE`, `REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION`, `REQ-ERROR-HANDLING`. - Core types and functions implement the story’s FS and performance requirements: - `StoryExistenceStatus`, `StoryPathCheckResult`, `StoryExistenceResult` capture existence state and associated error (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION). - `ProjectBoundaryCheckResult` + `enforceProjectBoundary(candidate, cwd)` enforce project boundaries by comparing normalized candidate to normalized cwd, ensuring no candidate outside the project is treated as valid (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY). - `buildStoryCandidates(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs)` (REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION): - If `storyPath` starts with `./` or `../`, only resolves against cwd. - Otherwise resolves directly under cwd, and additionally as basename under each configured storyDirectory (`path.resolve(cwd, dir, basename(storyPath))`). - `fileExistStatusCache` map caches existence checks per absolute path (REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION). - `checkSingleCandidate(candidate)` wraps `fs.existsSync`/`fs.statSync` in try/catch and returns: - `status: "exists"` only for regular files (stat.isFile()). - `status: "missing"` for non-existing or non-file entries. - `status: "fs-error"` capturing the error for any thrown exception, without rethrowing (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING). - Caches results back into `fileExistStatusCache`. - `getStoryExistence(candidates)` (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION): - Returns early with `status: "exists"` and `matchedPath` when any candidate exists. - Otherwise, if any candidate had `fs-error`, returns a `fs-error` result with that error. - Else returns `status: "missing"`. - `storyExists(paths: string[])` delegates to `getStoryExistence` and returns a boolean only, preserving compatibility. - `normalizeStoryPath(storyPath, cwd, storyDirs)` wraps candidate building and existence checking, returning `{ candidates, exists, existence }` for the rule to use. - Security and extension helpers: - `isAbsolutePath`, `containsPathTraversal`, `isTraversalUnsafe`, `hasValidExtension` (enforcing `.story.md`), `isUnsafeStoryPath` (REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION). - `__resetStoryExistenceCacheForTests()` clears the cache for clean test scenarios (REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION).

traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements for story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION are implemented and tested. The `traceability/valid-story-reference` rule inspects @story annotations, resolves paths using context.cwd and configurable storyDirectories, enforces the .story.md extension when required, prevents unsafe or out-of-project paths, and uses cached, exception-safe filesystem checks. Clear, specific diagnostics distinguish missing files, invalid extensions, invalid paths, and filesystem access errors. Behavior is thoroughly documented in docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md and validated by focused ESLint RuleTester suites and Jest tests that exercise file-existence scenarios, path resolution, project-boundary enforcement, configuration options, and filesystem error handling. The Jest test suite runs successfully via `npm test`. Therefore this story’s implementation is complete and passes.
